children: Overview
Hong Kong funeral services provider's half-year revenue declined from prior year
Company posted profit for the period after prior-year loss
Earnings per share turned positive after loss in previous period
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods
Result Drivers
NON-RESIDENTIAL PROJECT DECLINE – Construction-services revenue fell 22.3% to HK$22.6 mln due to lower contributions from non-residential projects
LOWER OPERATING EXPENSES – Administrative expenses fell to HK$16.2 mln from HK$17.0 mln, mainly due to lower operating expenses
LOWER BORROWING COSTS – Finance costs fell to HK$1.8 mln from HK$7.6 mln, primarily as interest on other borrowings declined
